ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
en: (1) Ḥā, Meem.
tr: Ḥā mīm

ar: عٓسٓقٓ
en: (2) ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.[1405]
enNotes: [1405]- See footnote to 2:1.
tr: ʿAyn sīn qāf

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (3) Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Kadhālika yūḥī ilayka waʾilal-ladhīna min qablikallāhul-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: (4) To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.[1406]
enNotes: [1406]- See footnote to 2:255.
tr: Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wahuwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm

ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (5) The heavens almost break from above them,[1407] and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
enNotes: [1407]- i.e., from the grandeur of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) above them.
tr: Takādus-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāʾikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fil-arḍ, alā innallāha huwal-ghafūrur-raḥīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
en: (6) And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager -
tr: Wal-ladhīnattakhadhū min dūnihī awliyāʾallāhu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim, wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīl

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (7) And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it[1408] and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
enNotes: [1408]- i.e., all other peoples.
tr: Wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qurʾānan ʿarabiyyal litundhira ummal-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawmal-jamʿi lā rayba fīh, farīqun fil-jannati wafarīqun fis-saʿīr

ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
en: (8) And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills[1409] into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
enNotes: [1409]- i.e., those who desire His guidance and His acceptance of them.
tr: Walaw shāʾallāhu lajaʿalahum ummataw wāḥidataw walākiy yudkhilu may yashāʾu fī raḥmatih, waẓ-ẓālimūna mā lahum miw waliyyiw walā naṣīr

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (9) Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Amittakhadhū min dūnihī awliyāʾ, fallāhu huwal-waliyyu wahuwa yuḥyil-mawtā, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
en: (10) And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."[1410]
enNotes: [1410]- In remembrance and repentance.
tr: Wamakhtalaftum fīhi min shayʾin faḥukmuhū ilallāh, dhālikumullāhu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkalt, waʾilayhi unīb

ar: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
en: (11) [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,[1411] and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.[1412]
enNotes:
[1411]- There is no similarity whatsoever between the Creator and His creation in essence, in attributes or in deed.
[1412]- See footnotes to 17:1.
tr: Fāṭirus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājaw waminal-anʿāmi azwājā, yadhraʾukum fīh, laysa kamithlihī shayʾ, wahuwas-samīʿul-baṣīr

ar: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (12) To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Lahū maqālīdus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu wayaqdir, innahū bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

ar: شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
en: (13) He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
tr: Sharaʿa lakum minad-dīni mā waṣṣā bihī nūḥaw wal-ladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihī ibrāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmud-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīh, kabura ʿalal-mushrikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayh, allāhu yajtabī ilayhi may yashāʾu wayahdī ilayhi may yunīb

ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
en: (14) And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
enNotes: [1413]- Decree. See footnote to 10:19.
tr: Wamā tafarraqū illā mim baʿdi mā jāʾahumul-ʿilmu baghyam baynahum, walawlā kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika ilā ajalim musammal laquḍiya baynahum, waʾinnal-ladhīna ūrithul-kitāba mim baʿdihim lafī shakkim minhu murīb

ar: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (15) So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad],[1414] and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.[1415] There is no [need for] argument between us and you.[1416] Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
enNotes:
[1414]- Another meaning understood from the Arabic is "So because of that [division and separation into sects], invite [them back to Allāh]..."
[1415]- i.e., the consequences thereof.
[1416]- Since the truth has been made clear and since those who refuse it do so only out of stubbornness or worldly interests.
tr: Falidhālika fadʿ, wastaqim kamā umirt, walā tattabiʿ ahwāʾahum, waqul āmantu bimā anzalallāhu min kitāb, waʾumirtu liʾaʿdila baynakum, allāhu rabbunā warabbukum, lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum, lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakum, allāhu yajmaʿu baynanā, waʾilayhil-maṣīr

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
en: (16) And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to[1417] - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
enNotes: [1417]- i.e., after people have accepted the truth from Allāh, in an attempt to turn the believers away from His religion of Islām.
tr: Wal-ladhīna yuḥājjūna fillāhi mim baʿdi mastujība lahū ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabuw walahum ʿadhābun shadīd

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
en: (17) It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī anzalal-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi wal-mīzān, wamā yudrīka laʿallas-sāʿata qarīb

ar: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (18) Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,[1418] but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
enNotes: [1418]- They had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to bring it on immediately.
tr: Yastaʿjilu bihal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bihā, wal-ladhīna āmanū mushfiqūna minhā wayaʿlamūna annahal-ḥaqq, alā innal-ladhīna yumārūna fis-sāʿati lafī ḍalālim baʿīd

ar: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
en: (19) Allāh is Subtle[1419] with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
enNotes: [1419]- See footnote in 12:100.
tr: Allāhu laṭīfum biʿibādihī yarzuqu may yashāʾ, wahuwal-qawiyyul-ʿazīz

ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
en: (20) Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
tr: Man kāna yurīdu ḥarthal-ākhirati nazid lahū fī ḥarthih, waman kāna yurīdu ḥarthad-dunyā nuʾtihī minhā wamā lahū fil-ākhirati min naṣīb

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (21) Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,[1420] it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
enNotes: [1420]- Decree. See footnote to 10:19.
tr: Am lahum shurakāʾu sharaʿū lahum minad-dīni mā lam yaʾdham bihillāh, walawlā kalimatul-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum, waʾinnaẓ-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīm

ar: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
en: (22) You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
tr: Taraẓ-ẓālimīna mushfiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿum bihim, wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍātil-jannāt, lahum mā yashāʾūna ʿinda rabbihim, dhālika huwal-faḍlul-kabīr

ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
en: (23) It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1421]
enNotes: [1421]- See footnote in 35:30.
tr: Dhālikal-ladhī yubashshirullāhu ʿibādahul-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāt, qul lā asʾalukum ʿalayhi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurbā, wamay yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahū fīhā ḥusnā, innallāha ghafūrun shakūr

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (24) Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart.[1422] And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
enNotes: [1422]- i.e., He could make you forget the Qur’ān and deprive you of it.
tr: Am yaqūlūnaftarā ʿalallāhi kadhibā, faʾiy yashaʾillāhu yakhtim ʿalā qalbik, wayamḥullāhul-bāṭila wayuḥiqqul-ḥaqqa bikalimātih, innahū ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
en: (25) And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī yaqbalut-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihī wayaʿfū ʿanis-sayyiʾāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūn

ar: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
en: (26) And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
tr: Wayastajībul-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlih, wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīd

ar: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
en: (27) And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.
tr: Walaw basaṭallāhur-rizqa liʿibādihī labaghaw fil-arḍi walākiy yunazzilu biqadarim mā yashāʾ, innahū biʿibādihī khabīrum baṣīr

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
en: (28) And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī yunazzilul-ghaytha mim baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatah, wahuwal-waliyyul-ḥamīd

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ
en: (29) And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
tr: Wamin āyātihī khalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baththa fīhimā min dābbah, wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāʾu qadīr

ar: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
en: (30) And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
tr: Wamā aṣābakum mim muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīr

ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
en: (31) And you will not cause failure [to Allāh][1423] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
enNotes: [1423]- i.e., escape from Him.
tr: Wamā antum bimuʿjizīna fil-arḍ, wamā lakum min dūnillāhi miw waliyyiw walā naṣīr

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
en: (32) And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
tr: Wamin āyātihil-jawāri fil-baḥri kal-aʿlām

ar: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
en: (33) If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
tr: Iy yashaʾ yuskinir-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrih, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil likulli ṣabbārin shakūr

ar: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ
en: (34) Or He could destroy them[1424] for what they earned; but He pardons much.
enNotes: [1424]- Meaning that Allāh could sink the ships by means of violent winds.
tr: Aw yūbiqhunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīr

ar: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
en: (35) And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
tr: Wayaʿlamal-ladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā, mā lahum mim maḥīṣ

ar: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
en: (36) So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
tr: Famā ūtītum min shayʾin famatāʿul-ḥayātid-dunyā, wamā ʿindallāhi khayruw waʾabqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
en: (37) And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
tr: Wal-ladhīna yajtanibūna kabāʾiral-ithmi wal-fawāḥisha waʾidhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: (38) And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
tr: Wal-ladhīnastajābū lirabbihim waʾaqāmuṣ-ṣalāh, waʾamruhum shūrā baynahum, wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
en: (39) And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].[1425]
enNotes: [1425]- Restoring their rights and not allowing aggressors to take advantage of them out of weakness.
tr: Wal-ladhīna idhā aṣābahumul-baghyu hum yantaṣirūn

ar: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (40) And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
tr: Wajazāʾu sayyiʾatin sayyiʾatum mithluhā, faman ʿafā waʾaṣlaḥa faʾajruhū ʿalallāh, innahū lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
en: (41) And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
tr: Walamanintaṣara baʿda ẓulmihī faʾulāʾika mā ʿalayhim min sabīl

ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (42) The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
tr: Innamas-sabīlu ʿalal-ladhīna yaẓlimūnan-nāsa wayabghūna fil-arḍi bighayril-ḥaqq, ulāʾika lahum ʿadhābun alīm

ar: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
en: (43) And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.[1426]
enNotes: [1426]- On the part of those seeking the reward of Allāh.
tr: Walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmil-umūr

ar: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
en: (44) And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
tr: Wamay yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū miw waliyyim mim baʿdih, wataraẓ-ẓālimīna lammā raʾawul-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddim min sabīl

ar: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ
en: (45) And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
tr: Watarāhum yuʿraḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna minadh-dhulli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyy, waqālal-ladhīna āmanū innal-khāsirīnal-ladhīna khasirū anfusahum waʾahlīhim yawmal-qiyāmah, alā innaẓ-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābim muqīm

ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
en: (46) And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
tr: Wamā kāna lahum min awliyāʾa yanṣurūnahum min dūnillāh, wamay yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min sabīl

ar: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ
en: (47) Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.[1427]
enNotes: [1427]- Of your sins or "disapproval" of your punishment.
tr: Istajībū lirabbikum min qabli ay yaʾtiya yawmul lā maradda lahū minallāh, mā lakum mim maljaʾiy yawmaʾidhiw wamā lakum min nakīr

ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٌ
en: (48) But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
tr: Faʾin aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓā, in ʿalayka illal-balāgh, waʾinnā idhā adhaqnal-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā, waʾin tuṣibhum sayyiʾatum bimā qaddamat aydīhim faʾinnal-insāna kafūr

ar: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
en: (49) To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
tr: Lillāhi mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yakhluqu mā yashāʾ, yahabu limay yashāʾu ināthaw wayahabu limay yashāʾudh-dhukūr

ar: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَٰثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
en: (50) Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
tr: Aw yuzawwijuhum dhukrānaw waʾināthā, wayajʿalu may yashāʾu ʿaqīmā, innahū ʿalīmun qadīr

ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
en: (51) And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
tr: Wamā kāna libasharin ay yukallimahullāhu illā waḥyan aw miw warāʾi ḥijābin aw yursila rasūlan fayūḥiya biʾidhnihī mā yashāʾ, innahū ʿaliyyun ḥakīm

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (52) And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
tr: Wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥam min amrinā, mā kunta tadrī mal-kitābu walal-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihī man nashāʾu min ʿibādinā, waʾinnaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
en: (53) The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
tr: Ṣirāṭillāhil-ladhī lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, alā ilallāhi taṣīrul-umūr
